messages:
maria: Quick sync — postmortem follow-up from last week's multi-region auth + model-registry degradation. I'm collecting final owners and firm timelines. Short list of actions below, please ack and add gaps.

maria: ACTION 1 — Cloud provider fallback drills: validate cross-region routing + cold-start time for Dedicated pools. Owner: aj. ETA: 2025-06-05 (sprint end). Please schedule a dry-run and report p95 cold-start. :calendar:

aj: acked. I'll run a canary failover drill during low-traffic window next Wed. I will paste results in this thread.

maria: ACTION 2 — Model registry auth caching TTLs causing token storms after rotation. Owner: devon. ETA: 2025-05-29. Dev, can you scope whether we need token sharding or client-side jitter first?

devon: scoped. Proposal: add jitter + pre-warming for token refresh, and patch registry to 30s slotted backoff. I'll open RFC and a patch. Ticket: TKT-8123.

rachel: TKT-8123 noted. Also flagging a compliance check for Private deployments — KMS rotation interaction. CC @devon

maria: ACTION 3 — Auth provider fallback policy: implement automatic fallback to cached short-lived keys plus circuit-breaker for provider errors. Owner: sam. ETA: 2025-06-12. Need runbook update and SLO delta assessment.

sam: taking it. I'll draft runbook edits and a canary smoke test. Want to rotate on-call ownership for this for the next 8 weeks to exercise it.

aj: quick question on measurements — do we track regression by model latency or by error-rate spikes? I think both but want a single alert to drive the drill.

maria: keep both; primary alert should be error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m, secondary alert p95 latency > 800ms for 5m. We'll add a dashboard tile.

ops-bot: Reminder — scheduled dry-run: aj will run canary failover on 2025-06-04 01:00 UTC. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend or :eyes: to follow post results.

devon: added RFC link: https://confluence.redwood/model-registry-token-jitter-RFC (draft). Patch branch: feature/token-jitter-TKT-8123. Will request review by EOD Fri.

rachel: I've created a tracking epic EPIC-3312 to consolidate follow-ups and weekly checkpoints. I'll own the weekly rollout review.

sam: suggestion — rotate the vendor-liaison role weekly so we don't have single-owner knowledge gaps. propose Rota: aj -> devon -> sam -> maria -> rachel. Agree?

aj: agree. I'll update the oncall doc after the drill.

maria: final ask — everyone put explicit rollback criteria in their PRs and runbook: what constitutes abort vs proceed. We'll reconvene next Tue 09:00 PT to close outstanding items. Thanks all. :heart:
